Three arms extracted from this 3-arm parallel RCT (Das et al. 2019, J Contemp Dent Pract). Group I received full-mouth SRP alone (`SI_alone`), Group II received SRP plus systemic doxycycline 1,600 mg over 14 days (`SI_plus_systemic_local_antimicrobial`), and Group III was an untreated control (`usual_care`). All arms had n=17 and 3-month follow-up.
